name: leadhunter-monorepo
description: LeadHunter AI Outreach Platform + OpenWA Monorepo Launcher

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend,openwa" -c "blue.bold,cyan.bold,green.bold" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:openwa"
scripts.build: cd backend && npx prisma generate && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
